_comment: Servicos de consultoria. Nada aqui pode descrever servico que o time nao executa. Sem numero de clientes, sem nome de cliente, sem promessa de resultado.
intro: Design, migration, recovery, and ongoing support. It's the same work that gave rise to the mentoring, done directly in your environment.

servicos.desc: Design and implementation of clusters, replicas, and contingency. RPO and RTO defined by what the business can afford to lose, not by what the vendor promises.
Version, platform, or datacenter moves, with a rollback plan written before starting. Includes operating system and architecture changes.
Strategy designed from the restore backward, not from the backup forward. With a tested recovery run — a backup that was never restored is just a big file.
Evidence-based diagnosis: execution plan, wait events, and what changed since the time it was running well.
A snapshot of what's running: what's out of support, what has no contingency, what will hurt at the next peak — and in what order it's worth fixing.

Migration and operation in the cloud, including what changes when the database stops being yours and becomes a managed service: automated backup, patching, failover, and the limits nobody reads before signing.

itens.desc: One migration, one incident, one assessment. Get in, fix it, document it, get out.
Scope and timeline locked before starting, with a rollback plan written on day one.
Environment support and monitoring: health routines, backup reviews, and someone to call when it hurts.

cta.texto: Describe your scenario and what's hurting. If it's not something we do, I'll tell you on the first call.
